Server side Basically Dds consumes the application PDU and, according to the internal logic, can decide to produce and transmit a new RTPS PDU through the transport layer. The DataWriter and DataReader represent internal functional blocks showing the mapping between a PDU and the related DDS middleware object (they are modeled in the ECUC by some DdsDataWriter/DdsDataReader). The RTPS processor repre- sents the logic of module. Considering the transmission direction, the application data is fed into the Dds T rans- former, which simply copies the VariableDataPrototype and ClientServer- Operation into a buffer that will serve as the content of the DdsRtpsDataTxPdu. In the reverse direction, the VariableDataPrototype and ClientServerOpera- tion results are similarly extracted from the received PDU. The TriggerInterface use case can be considered as a special case of the SenderReceiverInterface where the data is empty , so in this case the Dds T rans- former is not used.
